description: Buy API lookup credits or a one-off plan with Stripe MPP card payment. No BuiltWith API key required. Start without paymentCredential to get a 402 challenge; use an MPP-compatible Stripe wallet to authorize it, then retry the IDENTICAL purchase with paymentCredential. Keep the random UUID idempotencyKey secret and reuse it for retries/status, never for a different purchase. Success returns access_token for mpp-data or Bearer authentication on this MCP connection. This charges only the supplied SPT, never a saved card.

paymentCredential.description: Full Authorization: Payment ... header value from the Stripe MPP wallet

name: mpp-purchase
